function: Save the graphic data of the Model Window in an AutoCAD DXF, BMP or EMF.
menu_path: From the Main Menu select [File] > [Graphic Files]
usage:
Invoke the dialog box of Graphic Files to save the graphic data as a desired file format.

Enter a file name, select a file type and click on the Save button to generate a new file.
note: File type to save can be selected among *.*(All Files), *.emf (Emf Files), *.bmp (Bmp Files), *.jpg (JPG files), *.dxf (Dxf Files) and *.dwg (Dwg Files). When *.dxf is selected, the program internally generates Meta file (emf) and execute Tools > Convert Meta Files to DXF Files.
